snippet.title: SUPER BOMBERMAN COLLECTION – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
SUPER BOMBERMAN COLLECTION is available today on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: 
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/super-bomberman-collection-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

The party battle game SUPER BOMBERMAN is available as a collection, featuring a total of 7 titles with 12 versions!

This collection includes the long-awaited unreleased localized versions of SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 and 5 along with Boss Rush mode, support features, libraries, and more.

#Bomberman #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoSwitch #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
